summary: Tethered and autonomous drone-in-a-box systems for persistent defense and inspection missions.
editor_note: This is not just a drone airframe: the enclosure, tether, encrypted command link and remote operations are sold as one deployable system. Easy Mobile operates from vehicles and vessels, while Easy Site supports tethered or free-flight inspection. Published specifications make the integration inspectable, but certification, payload and endurance remain vendor claims, and defense use adds procurement, safety and governance risk.
why_featured: Persistent aerial systems in the field

product_evidence.claim: Easy Mobile publishes dimensions, weight, power, payload, flight-height and vehicle-or-vessel operating limits for its tethered deployment system.
The Easy Site page describes autonomous remote takeoff and landing, tethered and free-flight configurations, and inspection missions across multiple charging stations.
The company reports Blue UAS listing, NDAA compliance and quality certifications; these are official vendor claims and were not re-certified by VentureDex.

market_context.primary_user: Defense, public-safety and industrial operators needing persistent airborne sensing with remote deployment.
market_context.differentiation: A complete drone-in-a-box and tether system designed for persistent operation from fixed sites, vehicles and vessels.
market_context.why_now: The Series B supports additional production capacity, global operations and continued development of autonomous aerial systems.

risks.claim: Field performance, regulatory permission and safe use vary by mission; defense deployments also carry material procurement, civil-liberties and geopolitical risk.
risks.basis: VentureDex assessment based on official system specifications and Axios reporting.
